not_done_stated_plainly: RI-WLD03 R5's EXTERIOR half. The eight architecture kits are implemented as INTERIOR structure (452 kit meshes across the province), but game/src/world/province.js still draws no settlement buildings at all: `settlement.buildings` reaches the door table and a .length and nothing else. So the 202 buildings are still building-shaped doors from the street, VP04 is still terrain, and the townspeople this round put outdoors are standing on a bare pad. This is the largest remaining piece of the round-1 verdict and I did not attempt it.

The unique items now have bodies and can be picked up, but they are NOT in game/data/world/property/*.json zone contents, so taking one does not run the theft chain that W1-15 built and the critic verified. `unique_item.owner` is carried and unread.
Interior walls have no collision. `sim.cell` is the camera-cell collision set and no interior has one; that was true before this round and is still true. You can walk out through a wall.

RI-WLD13 N4/N5/N7: windows and storeys are now DERIVED (a rule over interior_kind, bounds_m and a declared stair) rather than authored fields. That is an implementation, not the data the item asks for. N7 (water) is untouched.

`state: "interior_firelit"` now draws Thorn Hall built from its record instead of scene.js's generic hall. That changes what VP05 and every capture staged through that state looks like. It is the intended improvement, but any piece holding a cross-wave comparison through interior_firelit should know.
shots_note: All three entered with ops:[['enterInterior',...]] and NO staging state. The round-1 critic had to stage both of their captures through state:'interior_firelit' because ops alone photographed the exterior; that is no longer true. The three rooms differ in size, palette, partitioning and fittings: the apothecary has a back room, Thorn Hall has a mezzanine over its floor, the gaol is windowless with an iron door and block masonry.

All 115 interiors built headless with no browser: 0 failures, 0 props with no table entry.

tools/world/w1-04-consumption.mjs --self-test: 7/7 GOES-RED, 13 skipped as un-invertible scenario rows. Every row with a defined disconnect, including the three new render rows, goes red when its consumer is cut.
The sweep's own control arm: sim.applyCell and _syncCell cut -> 0 of 115 drew the right cell. The instrument reproduces the round-1 build on demand.

Two defects were found by these instruments going red rather than by reading code: (1) my sweep asserted renderer.interiorId on the five hand-built named cells that never set it - a probe defect; (2) the room was cached on the interior id, so a perturbed record returned the cached room and three checks reported DEAD - a build defect, now keyed on the record's content.

A third defect was found by the fixed step THROWING: save/state.js rebuilds NPCs inline rather than through makeNPC, so `goal` was undefined and stepSchedule crashed. That path was also silently destroying W1-GIVER-PRESENCE's `post` on every load - an existing bug, now written and read back, plus a guard in stepSchedule so no third construction path can kill every stepping probe in the project.
method_deviations: Another agent's blanket commit swept my files into commits 0c8acfa/7d9a8e1 while I was working. I ran `git commit` at no point (RULES.md rule 28). This is the fourth time the pattern is on record.
The box was at 13-16 load and 18-30 headless_shell for this whole run, above RULES.md rule 21's ~8 cap. I launched ONE browser and kept it, and publish no timing figure.

The first sweep run was killed at 9m48s and restarted, because it was measuring a build without the palette cache and without the generic-hall restore, and would have been a number about code that is not shipped.
overlap_notes: game/src/engine.js is claimed by W1-05, W1-22-r2 (handed-off), W1-GIVER-PRESENCE (complete) and W1-SOULS-r3 (running). The blocking defect is in engine.js by construction (renderer.setCell has exactly one caller and it lives there), so the overlap is unavoidable rather than incidental. My edits are additive and confined to _applyCell/_afterStep and the sim hook block; I do not commit.
